name: substack-add-navigation-item
description: Add one external link to a Substack publication's navigation bar (Settings > Website > Navigation bar > Add item). Used to point aiwtf.substack.com at ai-wtf.org, the site that holds the same essays. The proof is the item listed in the publication JSON's navigationBarItems and on the settings page after a reload.
requires: Run from scripts/substack.mjs (command nav), which opens a Substack tab.
authorship: Mike Wolf (direction: cross-link the site and the Substack); Claude Fable 5.1 (CCc), 2026-09-23, from that day's look at the settings page.
anomalies: The Navigation bar section lives under Settings > Website; the address https://<sub>.substack.com/publish/settings?search=navigation shows it. Default items: Home /, Notes /notes, Archive /archive, About /about. The publication JSON field is navigationBarItems (an empty array while only defaults exist).

'Add item' opens a dialog titled 'Add navigation bar item' with two unnamed text inputs, placeholders 'Enter title…' and 'https://example.com', and buttons Cancel and Add. The inputs have no name or id, so the recipe selects them by placeholder.
Substack saves the item when Add is clicked; there is no separate Save.
